posts.title: What's a computer?
posts.description: One of the biggest changes to my life since I stepped away from social media is my relationship with computers and tech in general. Honestly, I generally don’t care anymore and overall that has been a good thing. I think. There is much, much more to this than just stepping away from my last bastion of social media (Mastodon).
